name: irishbredeventers
description: IrishBredEventers: Irish-bred eventing results (and the IBSR showjumping sister site). Cloudflare Workers (static assets) + D1 + R2.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply irishbredeventers --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev:ibsr: npm run build:ibsr && wrangler dev --env ibsr
scripts.db:migrate:local:ibsr: wrangler d1 migrations apply irishbredshowjumpers --local --env ibsr
scripts.deploy:ibsr: npm run build:ibsr && wrangler d1 migrations apply irishbredhorses --remote --env ibsr && wrangler d1 migrations apply irishbredshowjumpers --remote --env ibsr && wrangler deploy --env ibsr
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && wrangler d1 migrations apply irishbredeventers --local
scripts.content:local: node scripts/build-content-sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute irishbredeventers --local --file seed/starter-content.sql
scripts.content:remote: node scripts/build-content-sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute irishbredeventers --remote --file seed/starter-content.sql
